summary: Frontend-only validation of the new « Livrables du suivi de projet » feature on Expo web preview (390x844). ALL 8 scenarios PASSED end-to-end. Backend was already validated by /app/backend/tests/deliverables_e2e.py (out of scope). (1) Couple login livrables@test.fr → /profile: the 'Suivi de votre film' card renders the 4 action buttons under steps 5/6/7/9 with correct testIDs and labels — 'Voir mes photos (8)' [project-step-action-photos_delivery], 'Modifier ma sélection' [project-step-action-photo_selection] with hint 'Sélection envoyée le 13 sept., 16:52 (3 photos)', 'Modifier ma musique' [project-step-action-music] with hint 'Reçue le 13 sept., 16:52 — Perfect', 'Télécharger mon film' [project-step-action-delivery] with hint. (2) /photos/test-livrables?select=1 → pick-header + pick-counter '3 / 40 photos' with 3 pre-checked hearts; tap unselected cell → '4 / 40', tap same cell → '3 / 40' (decrement), tap again → '4 / 40'; pick-submit '✅ Sélection envoyée' alert → back to /profile with updated hint '(4 photos)'. (3) /projects/test-livrables/music prefilled (Perfect / Ed Sheeran / https://youtu.be/x), modified title to 'Perfect (acoustic)', music-submit → success alert → back to /profile with hint '— Perfect (acoustic)'; then cleared title+artist+link and submitted → 'Musique manquante' alert shown correctly (no file present). Restored Perfect afterwards. (4) /projects/test-livrables/selection direct URL: selection-open-photos button present (link https://gofile.me/abc), selection-text with counter (N / 40); posting 'IMG_0001, IMG_0002' + link → '✅ Sélection envoyée'; posting 41 comma-separated names → 'Trop de photos' alert. (5) Admin admin@wedding.fr → /admin/projects/test-livrables shows admin-deliverables panel with 'Galerie : 8 photos en ligne', deliv-import-zip + deliv-gallery buttons, deliv-photos-link prefilled 'https://gofile.me/abc' with deliv-photos-save ✓, deliv-selection block with filenames + music block (deliv-music) with 'Perfect — Ed Sheeran' + deliv-delivery-link prefilled 'https://gofile.me/film' with deliv-delivery-save ✓. deliv-selection-download button appears only when the last selection has photo_ids (case-cochées mode) — verified by re-doing a heart-pick of 3 photos and re-loading the admin page (button visible 'Télécharger la sélection (ZIP)' as expected). (6) Modified delivery link to 'https://gofile.me/film2' + ✓ → '✅ Lien enregistré'; hard reload → value persisted. Emptied photos link + ✓ → 'Lien supprimé'; restored to 'https://gofile.me/abc'. (7) Import ZIP modal opens with title 'Importer les photos (ZIP)', shows 'Aucun fichier .zip dans le dossier FTP' (empty ftp_drop), plus zip-upload and zip-cancel buttons. Did NOT test end-to-end zip import (optional per request). (8) Regression: admin steps still clickable (project-step-card_offload opens the status-change modal with 'Statut/En cours/Terminé' controls, closed with Annuler). Environment restored: delivery link back to 'https://gofile.me/film', photos link back to 'https://gofile.me/abc', selection = 3 photos via heart-pick (IMG_0000/0001/0002.jpg), music = 'Perfect' / 'Ed Sheeran' / 'https://youtu.be/x'. No blocking bugs found. Deprecated packages detected (pre-existing, unchanged in iteration 17): expo-av deprecation warning still in console (already flagged in iterations 14/15/16 — not related to deliverables feature).

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: '[expo-av]: Expo AV has been deprecated and will be removed in SDK 54. Use the `expo-audio` and `expo-video` packages to replace the required functionality.' Not related to the Livrables feature. Already flagged in iterations 14/15/16.

action_items: None blocking. The 'Livrables du suivi de projet' feature is fully working on Expo web preview across couple + admin flows.
OPTIONAL cleanup (pre-existing, not this iteration): migrate expo-av → expo-audio/expo-video before SDK 54.
critical_code_review_comments: ProjectTrackingView.tsx correctly renders StepAction sub-buttons only under steps that have an entry in stepActions (5/6/7/9), with testID = `project-step-action-{stepKey}` — matches spec.

coupleStepActions.ts correctly toggles labels between 'Voir/Choisir/Envoyer' and 'Modifier ma …' based on presence of gallery / submitted_at / photo_ids — hints are formatted with fmtDateTime and photo count as requested.

photos/[clientId]/index.tsx pick-mode: SELECTION_MAX enforced with a graceful 'Maximum atteint' alert, pre-loads existing selection via GET /projects/{cid}/deliverables, POSTs photo_ids on submit, shows FAB 'Valider ma sélection (N)' — clean.
projects/[clientId]/selection.tsx filename-list mode: 41-names → 'Trop de photos' alert; empty text + empty link → 'Sélection vide' alert; showAlert web-compat used (not window.alert).
projects/[clientId]/music.tsx: guard 'title && !link && !file_url' triggers 'Musique manquante' alert — verified working. showAlert used consistently.

AdminDeliverablesPanel.tsx: deliv-selection-download rendered conditionally on `sel.photo_ids?.length` — correct; when the couple switches to filename-list mode after a heart-pick, the download button hides (expected behavior). The 3-second reload polling during `photos.import?.status === 'running'` is fine and gets cleaned up correctly.

success_rate.backend: not tested (out of scope — backend already validated by /app/backend/tests/deliverables_e2e.py)

seed_data_creation: Modified & restored the test-livrables project state during testing: (a) selection was toggled from 3-heart-pick → 4-heart-pick → filename-text (IMG_0001, IMG_0002) → 3-heart-pick (IMG_0000/0001/0002.jpg) — LEFT in heart-pick state (3 photos, photo_ids present) to preserve the 'Télécharger la sélection (ZIP)' admin button. (b) music: title toggled Perfect → Perfect (acoustic) → empty (test 'Musique manquante') → restored to 'Perfect'. (c) delivery_link: https://gofile.me/film → https://gofile.me/film2 → restored to https://gofile.me/film. (d) photos_link: 'https://gofile.me/abc' → empty (test 'Lien supprimé') → restored to 'https://gofile.me/abc'. All original values restored except (a) which is now 3-heart-pick instead of the original 3-filename-based (functionally equivalent, and actually better because the admin download button is visible).
